facility_nozzle_fluoropolymer_pvdf.structural_purpose: High-pressure, solvent-resistant industrial fluid sorting nozzle. Sliced at a dense 0.12mm boundary layer with 100% solid concentric fills. This completely fuses the fluoropolymer strands, creating an airtight, non-porous structure that is impervious to ethanol, CO2, and acidic terpene exposure.
